customers.evidence: We believe our first responsibility is to the patients, doctors and nurses, to mothers and fathers and all others who use our products and services.

employees.evidence: We are responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We must provide an inclusive work environment where each person must be considered as an individual.

dei.evidence: We must respect their diversity and dignity and recognize their merit.

environment.evidence: protecting the environment and natural resources.

community.evidence: We are responsible to the communities in which we live and work and to the world community as well.

shareholders.evidence: Our final responsibility is to our stockholders. Business must make a sound profit.

integrity.evidence: We provide highly capable leaders and their actions must be just and ethical.

safety.evidence: Compensation must be fair and adequate and working conditions clean, orderly and safe.

innovation.evidence: We must experiment with new ideas. Research must be carried on, innovative programs developed

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, directive tone using 'must' throughout, with absolute rather than hedged commitments. Patients and customers are addressed first, then employees, communities, and stockholders last, framed as a sequenced 'final responsibility'. Uses a first-person plural 'we' voice. Distinctive wording includes the 'Credo' label and the reference to mistakes being paid for.
